profile_text.body:
SpaceX designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft. Founded in 2002, the company describes its ultimate goal as enabling people to live on other planets.

The company is headquartered in Hawthorne, California. According to held facts, SpaceX has a legal exposure count of 220 in California, though no specific cases are detailed in the available data. SpaceX does not currently have tracked AI products, MCP servers, or SEC filings in the reference site's registry.
